data.name: Allied Bank Limited
data.description: Allied Bank Limited, incorporated in Pakistan, is a scheduled Bank, engaged in commercial banking and related services. The long term credit rating of the Bank assigned by the Pakistan Credit Rating Agency Limited (PACRA) is ‘AAA’. Short term rating of the Bank is ‘A1+’. Ibrahim Holdings (Private) Limited is the parent company of the Bank and it’s registered office is in Pakistan. The Bank is the holding company of ABL Asset Management Company Limited.
